name: Kelin Textile hotel linen catalogue
description: Series and model tables published by Nantong Kelin Textile Co., Ltd. (Kelin Textile), based in Nantong, China. The catalogue covers hotel bedding sets, duvets, pillows, mattress toppers, mattress protectors, bed runners, bath linen, blankets, home bedding sets and bedspreads. Values as published in the 2026 product deck and in Kelin's own product information, each with its source.
note: Published by Kelin Textile at https://kelintextile.design.
